correctness.rationale: I reconstructed the geometry in the fixed 6-dimensional binary quadratic-form space. Among the 63 nonzero forms exactly 28 have nonzero characteristic-2 discriminant. There are 22 nonrational degree-3 Frobenius point orbits in P2(F8); 14 lie on F2-lines and 8 are noncollinear. Vanishing on each of those 8 triangles gives a 3-dimensional all-smooth net; any smooth conic has exactly two noncollinear Frobenius triangles among its 9 F8 points. Bezout prohibits two distinct conics containing the same two triangles, forcing a K8 edge bijection. Rational base-point incidence 9=3b+(7-b) gives b=1 for an all-smooth pencil, the remaining degree-3 base orbit gives a unique containing net, hence exactly 56 pencils. Seven pairwise-intersecting edges form a star, exhausting the nets and excluding dimensions >=4. The PGL3(F2) group of order 168 acts transitively (stabilizer 21). Independent full finite coefficient enumeration of 63 forms found 28 smooth conics, all 56 pencils, all 8 nets, 28 pairwise 1-dimensional net intersections and unique containment, corroborating the finite theorem. The F8 singular-line argument, not an F8-only point search, underlies geometric smoothness.
